G4720.name: Stachys
G4720.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4720.brief: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul as a beloved friend.
G4720.short: Stachys was a believer in Rome whom Paul greeted as his beloved friend.

G4734.name: Stephanas
G4734.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4734.brief: Corinthian believer, baptized by Paul, sent to visit him.
G4734.short: Stephanas was a believer from Corinth who, along with his household, was baptized by Paul and later visited Paul to provide support and encouragement.

G4736.name: Stephen
G4736.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4736.brief: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.
G4736.short: Stephen, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church, was full of faith and the Holy Spirit, performed miracles, and became the first Christian martyr after his powerful testimony before the Sanhedrin.

G4770.name: Stoic
G4770.brief: A Greek philosophical school encountered by Paul in Athens
G4770.short: The Stoics were a Greek philosophical school that emphasized reason, self-control, and the acceptance of fate, some of whom debated with Paul in Athens (<ref="Act.17.18">Act.17.18</ref>).
